setting: home-health / eldercare agency (C6, tongue-cruelty against the weak)
head_pair: (a) H1 example-followed-senior-aide + H4 public-before-the-watching-trainees-and-family  vs  (b) H2 party-especially-related-and-defenseless (the great-aunt who raised her, a bedridden dementia patient) + H3 year-long-continuance
case_a_worse: (a) carries TWO live Q151 aggravations the other side lacks: H1 (a person of eminency 'whose example is likely to be followed' — the model of the team every new hire copies) and H4 (done 'before others,' publicly, at shift-change in front of six trainees and two waiting family). Public sin by an example-setter is doubly aggravated under Q151: it not only wrongs the daughter but teaches contempt-for-clients to the watching trainees who model her, becoming an occasion of their sin. The corruption of a whole cohort's professional conduct is a real, ongoing harm that (b)'s private cruelty cannot touch. Q136's 'provoking words' before the vulnerable, magnified by office and publicity.
case_b_worse: (b) carries TWO different live aggravations (a) lacks: H2 (the party offended is one to whom she stands 'especially related and engaged unto' — the great-aunt who took her in as a teenager stands in a parent's place, and the victim is maximally defenseless: bedridden, demented, unable to report) and H3 (continuance — a settled year-long drip of cruelty, 'done with continuance, obstinately'). Q151 weighs both the nearness of the relation wronged and the helplessness of the party as aggravations; cruelty to one owed the most, who cannot resist or report, sustained for a year, is the gravest quality of the sin against the sixth commandment. (a)'s single outburst was even repented same-day.
why_neither_wins: The Standards supply no algebra to net (a)'s public, example-corrupting single act (H1+H4, teaching a cohort contempt) against (b)'s private, sustained cruelty to a defenseless specially-related dependent (H2+H3). Different heads, neither cancelled: (a)'s same-day apology is a MITIGATION (not a Q151 head) and does not undo H1/H4; (b) has no mitigation but also no publicity or example-corruption. Public-example-harm and sustained-cruelty-to-the-helpless-and-near are genuinely incommensurable weights.

setting: K-12 Christian school (C3, misuse of God's name)
head_pair: (a) H1 office/ordained-example-followed-Bible-teacher + H4 in-the-classroom-before-copying-children, lighter careless KIND  vs  (b) H3 the graver KIND (express profane cursing) + H3 persistence-after-admonition
case_a_worse: (a) carries H1 (an ordained officeholder 'whose example is likely to be followed,' the teacher faculty and students admire) and H4 (the setting aggravates: done daily in the very classroom where children are being formed in reverence, 'before others' who copy him). The pulpit/lectern trains reverence; a formative officeholder degrading the name day after day before impressionable children corrupts a whole cohort's habit of reverence — an example-harm (b) cannot reach. And it is continuous (settled habit), so H3-continuance is present on (a) too.
case_b_worse: (b) carries the graver KIND of the third-commandment sin — express profane cursing/abuse of the name (Q113's 'profane... abuse,' the stem's own label 'really abusing the name as a curse'), not mere careless filler — AND persistence-after-admonition (H3): warned by the principal, he brushed it off ('everyone does it') and still curses that way. Q151 head 3 aggravates continuance-after-reproof; the spurned admonition plus the intrinsically deeper kind of the act make (b) the graver in quality-of-act and obstinacy, which (a)'s merely careless (if public) filler lacks.
why_neither_wins: The Standards give no algebra to net (a)'s office-plus-formative-classroom-setting over a LIGHTER kind of the sin against (b)'s GRAVER kind of the sin plus obstinate persistence-after-reproof but no office/setting. Different heads (H1+H4-circumstance vs H3-kind+H3-persistence), neither cancelled. The stem labels the kinds so the grader needn't classify utterances. Head-pair mold deliberately differs from 023 (kind-vs-circumstance, not relation-vs-publicity).

head_pair: (a) H1 example-followed-lead-foreman + H4 done-openly-before-copying-apprentices  vs  (b) H2 party-specially-related-benefactor (owner who hired him as a favor, set him up, lent him rent) + H3 year-long-continuance
case_a_worse: (a) carries H1 (the lead foreman the apprentices imitate, who trained the crew — a person of eminency 'whose example is likely to be followed') and H4 (done openly, 'before others' who copy him — he effectively teaches the young guys that the trade includes skimming, an occasion of their sin). Q151 aggravates theft done publicly by a model who normalizes it for a whole crew; the corruption of the apprentices' honesty is an ongoing, spreading harm that private padding cannot match.
case_b_worse: (b) carries H2 (the party wronged is a specially-related benefactor — the owner hired him as a favor to a dying brother, set him up when no one else would, covers his tools, lent rent twice; Q151 weighs the nearness/obligation of the relation, and stealing from one's benefactor compounds gross ingratitude) and H3 (continuance — a careful, deliberate year-long embezzlement, 'done with continuance, obstinately'). The betrayal of a benefactor to whom one is bound, sustained for a year, is the graver relation-and-continuance profile against the eighth commandment.
why_neither_wins: No Standards algebra nets (a)'s open, example-corrupting theft (H1+H4, teaching a crew) against (b)'s private, sustained theft from a specially-obligated benefactor (H2+H3). (a)'s flat confession + immediate full restitution is a MITIGATION (and the restitution-remedy of Q142) that does NOT cancel the H1/H4 aggravations; (b) has neither restitution nor confession but no publicity/example-harm. Public-example-theft vs sustained-betrayal-of-a-benefactor are incommensurable.

head_pair: (a) H4 done-publicly-before-a-large-gathered-crowd (many misled at once)  vs  (b) H3 year-long-continuance + persistence-after-admonition, against a helpless trusting widow
case_a_worse: (a) carries H4 as its distinctive live aggravation: the lie was told publicly 'in the presence of others' — to a hundred-plus current and prospective customers at the open house who heard and believed it. Q151 aggravates sin done before many; here MANY are defiled/misled at once and the shop's public witness corrupted in a single act. Breadth of the deception (a whole crowd) is a real aggravation (b)'s one-victim fraud lacks.
case_b_worse: (b) carries H3 doubled — continuance (a settled year-long pattern of invented repairs and false charges, 'done with continuance, obstinately') AND persistence-after-admonition (the clerk warned him, he gave a false assurance he'd stopped, then concealed harder and kept going: Q151 head 3, the aggravating spurned-reproof plus false assurance). It also targets a maximally trusting, helpless party — a fragile elderly widow who relies entirely on his word (Q151's quality-of-offence: wronging the helpless-and-trusting is heavier). Depth, obstinacy, and defenselessness against (a)'s breadth.
why_neither_wins: No Standards algebra nets (a)'s public, many-defiling single deception (H4-breadth) against (b)'s private, sustained, admonition-defying deception of a helpless trusting widow (H3-continuance + H3-persistence + defenseless victim). Different heads, neither cancelled: (a)'s after-the-fact admission is a MITIGATION not undoing H4; (b) has the false assurance (an AGGRAVATION, not a mitigation). Note this item deliberately leads (a) with H4-breadth rather than H1-office, varying the mold from 023/025/027.

head_pair: (a) H1 example-followed-vice-president + H4 public-at-the-block-party-before-neighbors-and-children  vs  (b) H2 party-especially/sacredly-related (his own daughter-in-law, his son's wife) + H3 year-long-continuance + persistence-after-admonition
case_a_worse: (a) carries H1 (the vice-president the neighborhood looks to, whose conduct sets the association's tone — 'whose example is likely to be followed') and H4 (a public sexual pass at the packed block party 'before others' — dozens of neighbors and their children heard it, a public defiling that scandalizes the watching community). Public lewdness by the community's tone-setter, before children, aggravates under Q151 both by the person and by the place/publicity.
case_b_worse: (b) carries H2 at its heaviest — the party is his own daughter-in-law, his son's wife: Q139 explicitly names 'incest,' and the Standards weigh the sacred nearness of the relation as a grave aggravation (betraying his own son's marriage-bed). Plus H3 doubled: year-long continuance AND persistence-after-admonition with a false oath (a board member urged him to stop, he swore he would, then concealed harder and continued). An incestuously-near, sustained, obstinate affair is the graver relation-and-continuance profile.
why_neither_wins: No Standards algebra nets (a)'s public, example-corrupting single act (H1+H4, before the watching neighborhood) against (b)'s hidden, sustained, incestuously-near affair persisted-in-after-warning (H2+H3+H3). (a)'s next-morning shame is a MITIGATION not undoing H1/H4; (b)'s false oath is itself an AGGRAVATION. Same H1+H4-vs-H2+H3 family as 023, but the settings, commandment (C7 unchastity), and the incest-grade H2 make the concrete weights distinct.

setting: Christian hospice-care nonprofit leadership (C4, Sabbath profanation)
head_pair: (a) H1 ordained-director-example-followed-who-draws-others-in + H4 deliberate-collision-with-worship-time (displacing a cohort from worship)  vs  (b) H3 obstinate-continuance + persistence-after-admonition, purely her own
case_a_worse: (a) carries H1 (an ordained deacon the whole staff models — 'whose example is likely to be followed' — who ALSO actively draws others in: he leans on younger staff to skip church and work the gala, occasioning a whole cohort's sin, an aggravation under Q151) and H4 (the circumstance of time: the gala is deliberately timed to overlap the worship service, so the profanation is compounded by displacing worship for a cohort of new hires). Leading a whole cohort away from public worship by office and pressure is a spreading, ongoing harm.
case_b_worse: (b) carries H3 doubled — obstinate continuance (a settled weekly pattern of ordinary Sunday errand-shifts by free choice, 'done with continuance, obstinately') AND persistence-after-admonition (the supervisor pointed it out, she promised to stop, then rearranged to keep doing it more discreetly — Q151 head 3's spurned-reproof plus false assurance). The naked obstinacy against a direct admonition, with a broken promise, is a distinct aggravation (a) lacks (a is open, not admonition-defying).
why_neither_wins: No Standards algebra nets (a)'s office-plus-drawing-a-cohort-away-plus-worship-collision (H1+H4) against (b)'s obstinate, admonition-defying private continuance (H3+H3). Both are stipulated ordinary/optional (works of necessity/mercy explicitly excluded in the stem, so hospice-care duties don't confound). Head-pair mold deliberately differs from the others: an occasioning-others + worship-collision profile vs a pure obstinate-persistence profile, neither cancelled.

head_pair: (a) H3 obstinate-year-long-continuance persisted-in-after-repeated-admonition (relapsing after being spoken to twice)  vs  (b) H1 shop-star-example-followed + H4 public-at-the-front-counter-before-waiting-room-and-copying-apprentices
case_a_worse: (a) carries H3 at its most aggravated form — 'done with continuance, obstinately,' a settled year-long pattern of propositioning customers, AND 'continued after admonition' twice over, relapsing again and again, plainly meaning to keep it. Q151 head 3 weighs sin persisted-in-after-repeated-reproof as gravely aggravating; an obstinate predator who will not stop by talking is a live, forward-looking danger to every future customer, a depth-and-obstinacy the single repented incident of (b) lacks.
case_b_worse: (b) carries H1 (the shop's informal star the apprentices copy, whose example sets how the young guys behave — 'whose example is likely to be followed') and H4 (a public advance at the front counter during the morning rush 'before others' — the whole waiting room and the apprentices he mentors heard it). Public lewdness by the model of the young men, before the copying apprentices, aggravates by both person and publicity, and corrupts the watching cohort — an example-harm (a)'s private conduct cannot reach.
why_neither_wins: No Standards algebra nets (a)'s private, obstinate, admonition-defying year-long predation (H3+H3, no witnesses/no following) against (b)'s public, example-corrupting single advance (H1+H4). This item deliberately INVERTS the usual side-assignment — the multi-aggravator continuance profile is side (a) and the office/public profile is side (b) — to vary the mold. (b)'s same-day self-disgust is a MITIGATION not undoing H1/H4; (a) has no mitigation but no publicity/example-harm. Incommensurable.

setting: small Reformed church membership (C2, false worship / will-worship / images)
head_pair: (a) H1 teaching-elder-example-followed-who-leads-the-whole-assembly-in + H4 done-in-public-Lord's-Day-worship (corrupting the congregation's worship)  vs  (b) H3 obstinate-private-continuance + persistence-after-admonition, touching no one else
case_a_worse: (a) carries H1 (a teaching elder 'whose example is likely to be followed,' the congregation imitates him, and he ACTIVELY leads the whole assembly into image-veneration and will-worship — occasioning the entire church's sin, a grave Q151 aggravation) and H4 (the setting: done in public Lord's Day worship in the assembly, so the corruption of God's ordained worship — a breach of the regulative principle, WCF 21.1 — is compounded by place and the leading-astray of all present). Corrupting a whole congregation's public worship is the widest possible example-and-occasioning harm.
case_b_worse: (b) carries H3 doubled — obstinate private continuance (a settled, deliberate syncretic devotional habit, 'done with continuance, obstinately') AND persistence-after-admonition (a friend warned her it was forbidden worship, she said she'd give it up, then became more secretive and continued — Q151 head 3's spurned-reproof plus false assurance). The obstinacy against a loving direct admonition, with a broken promise, is a distinct aggravation (a) lacks (a is openly convinced, not admonition-defying).
why_neither_wins: No Standards algebra nets (a)'s office-plus-corrupting-the-whole-assembly's-public-worship (H1+H4, leading all present into false worship) against (b)'s obstinate, admonition-defying PRIVATE false worship touching no one else (H3+H3). Different heads, neither cancelled. C2 is a thin bank slot; the head-pair (occasioning-the-assembly + public-worship-corruption vs pure obstinate-private-persistence) is distinct from the batch's other molds.

head_pair: (a) H1 dean-of-students-example-followed + H4 made-public-before-a-roomful-of-teachers (shared screen)  vs  (b) H2 party-especially-related/bound (the wife of his own close friend of many years) + H3 year-long-continuance + persistence-after-admonition
case_a_worse: (a) carries H1 (the dean of students the whole staff models, whose example sets the culture — 'whose example is likely to be followed') and H4 (the crude sexual message landed on a shared screen and was seen by a roomful of teachers during the all-staff day — publicized 'before others,' a public defiling that scandalizes the watching staff). Public lewdness by the culture-setter, before the assembled staff, aggravates by both person and publicity.
case_b_worse: (b) carries H2 (the party wronged is one to whom he stands especially related and bound — the wife of his own close friend of many years, the man he owes loyalty; Q151 weighs the nearness/trust of the relation, and betraying a near friend's marriage compounds the wrong) and H3 doubled (year-long continuance AND persistence-after-admonition with a false promise: an acquaintance urged him to stop, he promised he would, then concealed harder and continued). Sustained betrayal of a bound friend's marriage, persisted-in against reproof, is the graver relation-and-continuance profile.
why_neither_wins: No Standards algebra nets (a)'s public, example-corrupting single act (H1+H4, before the watching staff) against (b)'s hidden, sustained betrayal of a near friend's marriage persisted-in-after-warning (H2+H3+H3). (a)'s within-the-hour admission is a MITIGATION not undoing H1/H4; (b)'s false promise is an AGGRAVATION. Shares the H1+H4-vs-H2+H3 family with 027 but uses a friend-loyalty H2 (not incest-grade) and a publicized-message H4 (not a spoken pass), keeping the concrete weights and setting distinct.
